FM15.reasoning: The agent solely evaluates and optimizes for accuracy without verifying performance on other metrics like F1 or ROC-AUC, which is risky given the dataset's class imbalance.

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage in feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Group-level aggregations (like calculating the mean of a feature grouped by a categorical variable) are performed on the concatenated train and test datasets. This causes test set feature distributions to leak into the training data.

summary: The agent implements a solid CatBoost model with K-fold cross validation and proper threshold optimization. However, calculating group aggregations on the combined train and test dataset introduces critical data leakage into the features. Additionally, the agent relies entirely on accuracy for evaluation, ignoring the imbalanced nature of the dataset.
